en: Welcome to the Battle Dome! Sixteen Trainers meet in a tournament, and four wins in a row make a champion.
You've won {number} tournaments in a row. The field gets tougher with every one!
Would you like to enter a tournament?
You need three Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Please choose the three Pokémon you'll enter.
Thank you! The bracket has been drawn. This way to the hall, please!
I'm sorry. The three entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the three entered may hold the same item.
Please come again. There's always another tournament about to begin.
Your three battle at Level 50, or at their own level if it's lower. Nothing you do here changes them.
Before every match you'll see your opponent's three, and you send two of yours into a battle of one on one.
Win the final and you're the champion. Lose a match, and the tournament is over for you.
